
# KinFeast

> KinFeast is a recipe discovery platform where people can
> explore delicious recipes, discover talented chefs, and
> find inspiration for their next meal.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://kinfeast.vercel.app/)
- [Recipes](https://kinfeast.vercel.app/recipes)
- [Categories](https://kinfeast.vercel.app/categories)
- [Chefs](https://kinfeast.vercel.app/chefs)
- [Trending Recipes](https://kinfeast.vercel.app/trending)
- [Cook With What You Have](https://kinfeast.vercel.app/cook-with-what-you-have)
